problems: Jin has no land from -403 to its end (-369), before and after this patch: wei/ledger/0 (found, counterpart jin) includes the Anyi 100 km disc, which covers the whole Houma 45 km rump, and takes all 32 rump cells at -403 (trial: 21 jin -> wei, 11 none -> wei). So the override's 'Jin keeps Jiang and Quwo afterwards' is not what the map draws. A ruling cannot fix it (a same-year event and R2 settle first). Fix in the dossiers: subtract {"place": "Houma", "km": 45} from wei/ledger/0's region and from the wei keyframes alive until Jin ends (wei_-404, wei_-381, and on to -370), or end Jin at the year a page gives (Partition of Jin: 'In 386 BCE ... deposed Duke Jing of Jin and divided the last remaining Jin territory ... which marked the end of the Jin state'). The window agent's report does not mention this.

Side effect of keyframe_overrides/0: jin/ledger/9 (split to han, region = Cliopatria Han -404) now passes 5 Wenyu cells (262344, 262403-262404, 262576-262577) to han for -403..-376, although han's found and keyframes cut Wenyu out as the wei dossier's. They were ownerless before; han_-375 will drop them as a 5-cell snap in m0400-m0301. A clean fix is a jin dossier edit making the three split regions equal to the successors' found regions.

The jin_-404 shape (Houma 45 km = 32 cells, about 8,100 km2) is the dossier's reading of 'only Jiang County and Quwo County'; the page gives no extent and the gazetteer has neither Quwo nor Jiang County, so it was left unchanged. It lies wholly inside wei's Anyi 100 km disc, which is the cause of the first problem.
keyframe_overrides/0 lasts to -370, into m0400-m0301; that window's patch has no jin, wei, han or zhao override, so there is no clash now.
